content.value_statement: Options and warrant data can be hard to compare across chains, Greeks, and volatility signals. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Longbridge workflows for quotes, chains, strategies, P&L, IV, and HK warrants.
actual_capabilities: Guides option quote, option chain, and option volume workflows for HK and US markets.
Explains OCC option symbols and maps terms for calls, puts, strikes, expiries, and IV.
Builds options strategy suggestions from market view, IV level, liquidity, and live chain data.
Computes payoff, breakeven, max profit, max loss, and net Greeks for option positions.
Compares implied volatility with historical volatility and describes smile, skew, and percentile context.
Guides HK warrant and CBBC quote, list, and issuer workflows.
limitations: Requires Longbridge CLI or MCP data tools to retrieve live market data.
US options require market access, and HK warrant coverage is limited to Hong Kong instruments.
Strategy outputs are educational references and are not investment advice.
Accuracy depends on available chain liquidity, quote fields, and historical price data.

use_cases.title: Compare Option Chains
use_cases.description: Review expiries, strikes, calls, puts, volume, open interest, IV, and Greeks before narrowing a contract list.

use_cases.title: Assess HK Warrants
use_cases.description: Find Hong Kong warrants or CBBCs for an underlying and compare quote fields, issuer data, leverage, IV, and premium.

use_cases.title: Model Strategy Risk
use_cases.description: Estimate payoff, breakeven, max loss, Greeks, IV regime, and skew signals for single-leg or multi-leg positions.

prompt_templates.title: Check an Option Chain
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of available expiries and strikes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Longbridge data to summarize the option chain for AAPL.US. Show expiries, active strikes, call and put volume, and notable IV levels.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Contract Quote
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a known option symbol.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this OCC option symbol with Longbridge data: AAPL240119C190000. Explain price, IV, Greeks, volume, open interest, and key risks.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Strategy selection from a market view.
prompt_templates.prompt: I am moderately bullish on TSLA.US for one month. Compare a long call, bull call spread, and bull put spread using Longbridge chain data.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Volatility and Skew
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a volatility snapshot for 700.HK. Compare ATM IV, 60-day historical volatility, IV percentile, put skew, and possible strategy signals.

output_examples.input: Summarize the AAPL.US option chain for the nearest liquid expiry.
output: Nearest active expiry found with several liquid strikes around spot.
ATM calls and puts have the highest useful comparison value for IV and Greeks.
Call and put volume can be used as sentiment context, not as a standalone signal.

output_examples.input: Compare a covered call and protective put for 700.HK.
output: Covered call may reduce cost basis but caps upside.
Protective put preserves upside but adds premium cost.
Liquidity should be checked before using either structure for a Hong Kong underlying.

output_examples.input: Explain whether IV looks rich for TSLA.US.
output: ATM IV is compared with a 60-day historical volatility proxy.
A high IV percentile can favor premium-selling strategies if risk controls are defined.
Skew and liquidity should be reviewed before selecting strikes.

best_practices: Provide the market, symbol, expiry window, and whether you need quotes, strategy, P&L, or volatility analysis.
Ask for risk metrics with every strategy, including max loss, breakeven, Greeks, liquidity, and IV context.
Treat strategy output as educational analysis and verify all live data before making any trade decision.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for trade execution or personalized financial advice.
Do not rely on IV percentile, call-put volume, or skew as a single decision signal.
Do not compare warrants or options without checking expiry, strike, issuer, liquidity, and underlying market.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides market data workflows and educational analysis only.

faq.question: Which markets does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers HK and US options workflows, plus Hong Kong warrants and CBBCs.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Basic option and warrant commands are described as public, but US options may require market access.

faq.question: Can it explain Greeks?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains delta, gamma, theta, vega, and how they affect option positions.

faq.question: Can it compare implied and historical volatility?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides ATM IV, historical volatility, IV percentile, smile, and skew analysis.

faq.question: Is the output investment advice?
faq.answer: No. The skill frames strategy results as educational references, not recommendations to buy or sell.
